extensions.msbuildguard.general.autoOpen.title: Auto-open Security Review
extensions.msbuildguard.general.autoOpen.description: Automatically open Security Review when opening a solution or project.

extensions.msbuildguard.general.scanNuGe.title: Scan NuGet packages
extensions.msbuildguard.general.scanNuGe.description: Include package-provided .props/.targets and related NuGet assets during scanning.

extensions.msbuildguard.trustManagement..title: Allow sharing trusts in repositories
extensions.msbuildguard.trustManagement..description: When enabled, MSBuild Guard removes managed .msbuildguard ignore entries from .gitignore files. When disabled, the entries are enforced.

extensions.msbuildguard.ruleIndicators.p.title: Process creation indicators
extensions.msbuildguard.ruleIndicators.p.description: Semicolon-separated tokens used to detect process creation or shell execution in code/commands.

extensions.msbuildguard.ruleIndicators.r.title: Reflection/interop indicators
extensions.msbuildguard.ruleIndicators.r.description: Semicolon-separated tokens used to detect reflection, dynamic loading, or native interop patterns.

extensions.msbuildguard.ruleIndicators.a.title: Additional blocked assemblies
extensions.msbuildguard.ruleIndicators.a.description: Semicolon-separated assembly names that should be treated as blocked when referenced.

extensions.msbuildguard.general.enableBa.title: Enable Baseline Onboarding
extensions.msbuildguard.general.enableBa.description: Prompt to set up a trusted baseline when loading a new solution or project.

extensions.msbuildguard.trustManagement..title: Key Management Mode
extensions.msbuildguard.trustManagement..description: Solo Developer (Local DPAPI) uses local machine keys, disabling repository sharing. Team Environment (Certificates) uses public/private certificate keys.

extensions.msbuildguard.trustManagement..title: Enforce Asymmetric Signatures
extensions.msbuildguard.trustManagement..description: Strictly enforces asymmetric certificate-based signature verification for trust stores and policy documents.
